context:
Goal: design fixes get the normal review rounds instead of landing late.
Problem (rule): decision design-agents puts the design reviewer after the build with no place against the code rounds; in degen it ran after code round 3 (PRs 385 and 386), so its code fixes always land late.
Based on (read): docs/decisions/design-agents.md:12: 'The design reviewer runs after the build.'
Based on (incident): degen PRs 385 and 386 (degen page item 83).
Departs from: design-agents, design reviewer after the build — it runs beside code review round 1 on the first built head.

options.gain: Design fixes ride the normal rounds and never land late.
options.how: The design reviewer runs on the first built head, beside code round 1; its findings join that round's fix.
options.label: Beside code round 1
options.lose: It may judge a screen that changes again in round 2.

options.gain: Every screen change, early or late, gets a design read.
options.how: The design reviewer joins each code round, on the same head.
options.label: In every code round
options.lose: Up to three design reads per lane instead of one.

options.gain: It judges the finished screen once.
options.how: Keep it after the build, but its findings get one fix and one design re-read before merge, outside the code cap.
options.label: At the end, with its own fix round
options.lose: Design fixes still come last and add a round to every lane.

options.gain: No change to the agents or the skill.
options.how: Leave design-agents as it is; a late design fix goes through the item 203 fix check only. A bandaid.
options.label: Keep the order, rely on the fix check
options.lose: Design fixes still land after round 3 every time.

ref: step late-review-fixes; lane session_013NEJL2mkqxZo8g998PyeoS report, branch late-review-fixes head 93af114c; degen page item 83
reply: Landed: claude-settings #1231 merged in batch 10 (main 59bff081, Nov 5 06:36 CST); the design reviewer runs beside code round 1.
title: When should the design reviewer run, so its fixes do not land after the last code review?
why: Running it beside round 1 fixes the cause; the fix check alone only shortens the wait.
